note: Set A correctly binds most dimensions to their specific details (e.g., A6 values to Landscape Footing, C3 values to Footing Elevation), whereas Set B frequently misattributes values to the wrong components or details, such as assigning the 8'-0" width from C3 to C1 and misidentifying the 7 1/2" pier height as joist depth. Set A contains only one clear orientation error (labeling the 8'-0" width as height), while Set B includes invented grid references and multiple misbindings of A6 data to other details. Both sets suffer from excessive redundancy, but Set A is significantly more accurate in its entity-value associations.
